summary: Proposes the strongest faithful V4 repair: a clean-room PCFL M0 instrument with zero FeltCraft runtime reuse, a two-freeze fixture path, neutral actor handles, non-oracular actions, bundled graph reading with a first-action cut, a fixed delayed-entry factorial assay, and an 18-condition supplied-memory M-TEXT protocol. It recommends only later authoring of an exact inert preparation-source bundle after human ratification.
system_thesis: Dream–LoRA–Think is a recurrent complete organism. Lived action–outcome episodes supply grounded public evidence; DREAM later and target-independently grows local candidate connections and re-expressions; independent later evidence supports or revokes them; SLEEP consolidates only validated personal semantics through transactional parametric/LoRA transport; THINK retrieves, composes, plans, acts, observes, and revises under a goal; and later thought/outcomes may seed future dream cycles. V4 implements neither DREAM authorship nor SLEEP/LoRA transport. M0 is a finite lived-world instrument; M-TEXT tests only goal-conditioned use of supplied connected text plus separately supplied calibrated evidence. Any positive result belongs to that bounded relay, not to an organ discovering knowledge or to the complete learning organism.
title: Clean-room PCFL M0 V4 and bounded M-TEXT supplied-memory relay with two-freeze authority
